nina_csm: Seeing a sharp hosted spend blip in today's health scan for three accounts around 09:07 UTC. automated detector flagged high short-window variance (score=0.93).

leo_data: Quick summary: cust-harbor peak ~3.8x baseline for ~14m, cust-tsunami ~2.4x, cust-petal ~1.9x. query I used below.

leo_data: ```sql
SELECT org, sum(tokens) as tokens, max(tokens_per_min) as peak_tpm
FROM hosted_usage
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-19T09:00:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-19T09:30:00Z'
GROUP BY org
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

odar_ops: (typo: i'm omar_ops) Checking infra side: we had a minor routing tweak to canary pool at 09:02 UTC, but no autoscaler alerts. will grep gateway logs for 429 spikes.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: canary routing tweak applied in us-west at 2026-03-19T09:02:11Z.

dina_fin: Provisional exposure if sustained: cust-harbor $14.2k vs commit $4.5k. marking "high variance" for reconciliation.

nina_csm: CSM owners please note — prefer proactive outreach if finance flags are high. who owns cust-harbor?

leo_data: Traces show high session concurrency for cust-harbor during the window and a 3.1% bump in 429s that map to the same org ids. looks like a client fanout pattern plus a short rate-limit pressure.

omar_ops: confirmed 429s concentrated 09:05-09:11 UTC and align to cust-harbor request IDs. no 5xx surge. likely client retries + new-session pattern.

dina_fin: Finance suggests holding automatic adjustments; recommend offering a one-time goodwill credit if customer reports billing surprise. propose cap $2k for cust-harbor.

nina_csm: Actions: 1) leo to export org-specific request/session ids and mark retries (ETA 90m). 2) omar to add temporary rate-smoothing to canary routes (ETA 30m). 3) dina to prepare credit wording/approval threshold (ETA EOD). 4) nina to draft outreach template and hold until we confirm root cause.

leo_data: Starting export now. will DM CSV to nina and omar. :mag:

omar_ops: I'll deploy the rate-smoothing override and monitor for 45m, ping when live. :gear:

billingbot: billing: provisional estimate for cust-harbor = $14,200 if sustained. awaiting finalization.

nina_csm: Good work. Let's capture this variant detector in the weekly pack: short spikes 5-20m vs commit baseline, plus linked infra events. keep replies short here so we have an audit trail. :white_check_mark:
